_comment_num_iter: Total iterations. First warmup_iterations use uniform sampling, rest use adaptive sampling
_comment_warmup_iterations: Number of warmup iterations with uniform sampling (Phase 1). Recommend 2-5.
_comment_cache_update_frequency: Update admissibility cache every N iterations during adaptive phase
_comment_cache_grid_size: Number of grid points to sample when updating cache
_comment_plot_admissibility_frequency: Generate admissibility heatmaps every N adaptive iterations
_comment_verbose_cpp_analysis: Set to false to suppress detailed C++ data analysis output in console
_comment_history_size: Number of previous iterations to keep for sampling. Options: 1 (latest only), 3-5 (standard), 10+ (complex problems)
_comment_use_txt_pretraining: Set to true to run pre-training from policy_v6_out_61.txt, false to load from model_number_input
_comment_admissibility_thresholds: Thresholds for categorizing admissibility scores A(B,λ,g)
_comment_threshold_interpretation: A > strong_admissible: Strongly admissible, inadmissible < A < strong_admissible: Transition, A < inadmissible: Inadmissible
_comment_scoring_parameters: Defines rules for 6-point scoring and dynamic bounds
_comment_penalty_params: Epsilon values for penalty functions in obj_sim_value. Now also holds primary tau/b bounds.
